name: Ascend
description_en:
Ascend’s official website now says the company is winding down operations. The notice describes its former work in declarative data pipelines, ingestion, transformation, orchestration and agentic data engineering. Those historical descriptions should not be read as confirmation of a currently purchasable service.

The former pricing page displays the same notice. Current subscription prices, new-account availability, a final shutdown date and migration support were not established. This record preserves the project’s identity and reports the official change rather than recommending a new production dependency.
description_zh:
Ascend 官网现已说明公司正在结束运营。公告回顾了其声明式数据流水线、数据摄取、转换、编排与 Agent 数据工程工作；这些历史描述不能视为当前仍可购买服务的证明。

原定价页显示同一公告。本次未确认当前订阅价格、新账户可用性、最终停运日期或迁移支持。本档案保留项目身份并报告官方变化，不建议据此建立新的生产依赖。

core_features.explanation_en: The winding-down notice describes the earlier pipeline approach; current availability is unverified.
core_features.explanation_zh: 结束运营公告回顾了先前的流水线方式，当前可用性未核实。

core_features.explanation_en: The notice recalls ingestion, transformation and orchestration in one platform.
core_features.explanation_zh: 公告回顾了曾在同一平台组合摄取、转换与编排。

en: Review an existing Ascend dependency against the official wind-down notice.
zh: 依据官方结束运营公告复查现有 Ascend 依赖。

steps.zh: 开始新接入前先核实服务及合同连续性。

pricing.billing_basis: Former pricing page replaced by official wind-down notice; current amount and renewal terms unknown.

sources.title: A note from Team Ascend
sources.research_notes_en: Official homepage explicitly announces winding down; no final cessation date, migration process or export guarantee supplied.

sources.title: A note from Team Ascend
sources.research_notes_en: The former pricing URL returns the same winding-down notice, not an active price or sales offer.

review_notes: Original AI research draft based on the cited public official pages; no publication, price approval, independent review or product test is implied.
Earlier third-party feature and price claims are retained only in discovery provenance, not as current product evidence.

sections.title_en: The operating-status notice takes precedence over old listings
sections.title_zh: 运营状态公告优先于旧目录描述
sections.en: The relevant current fact is the vendor’s own wind-down announcement. It does not specify a final cessation date or say that every existing workload has already stopped. Preserve that distinction: winding down is verified; complete shutdown on a particular date is not. Old feature labels and third-party prices cannot establish whether a new customer can onboard today.
sections.zh: 当前关键事实是厂商自己的结束运营公告。公告未给出最终停止日期，也没有说明所有现有负载都已停止。应保留区别：正在结束运营已经核实，具体某日完全停运尚未核实。旧功能标签与第三方价格不能证明现在仍能让新客户接入。

sections.title_en: Describe the former category without promising an active product
sections.title_zh: 说明历史类别，避免承诺在售能力
sections.en: The notice places Ascend in the history of data-pipeline and data-engineering platforms. It does not provide current connector documentation, execution limits, deployment instructions or entitlement terms. This profile therefore does not invent a live workflow walkthrough from historical marketing. A prospective evaluator should resolve commercial availability before spending time configuring source credentials or sending production data.
sections.zh: 公告把 Ascend 放在数据流水线与数据工程平台的历史背景中，没有提供当前连接器文档、执行限制、部署指引或权限条款。因此本文不根据历史营销补写仍有效的操作教程。潜在评估者应先核清商业可用性，再投入源凭据配置或传输生产数据。

sections.title_en: There is no active price established by the pricing URL
sections.title_zh: 原定价 URL 未提供现行价格
sections.en: The pricing URL now returns the wind-down notice. No amount, billing unit, trial condition or renewal term can be established from it. Unknown is not zero: the absence of a price is not a free plan, and a reachable page is not a working subscription service. This record marks the current offer as unestablished and does not normalize the previous directory price.
sections.zh: 定价 URL 现返回结束运营公告，无法由此确定金额、计费单位、试用条件或续约条款。未知不等于零：没有价格不是免费套餐，网页可访问也不等于订阅服务可用。本文把当前报价标为未确认，不再标准化旧目录金额。

sections.title_en: An existing deployment needs its own continuity check
sections.title_zh: 现有部署需单独核对连续性
sections.en: For an existing user, our suggested inventory includes source/destination definitions, transformation logic, schedules, credentials under your control, current job results and any retained data needed for migration. Verify export and support options through the existing account agreement or vendor contact before relying on them. The public notice does not establish an export method, retention deadline, refund right or automatic transfer to another provider; none is promised here.
sections.zh: 对于现有用户，建议清点源和目标定义、转换逻辑、调度、自有凭据、当前任务结果，以及迁移所需保留数据。依赖导出或支持前，应通过现有账户合同或厂商联系方式核实。公开公告并未确定导出方法、保留截止日、退款权利或向其他厂商自动迁移，本文不作这些承诺。
